mostWorthwhile.text: Making the membrane pump work was worthwhile because it showed ATP powering movement toward the crowded side after the pump was installed.

leastWorthwhile.text: The direct ATP-and-pump attempt was confusing: the picture suggested a connection, but the pump had to be installed first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that ATP could not combine directly with the pump, even though the ATP picture pointed to it.

arbitrary.text: The need to install the pump first made physical sense once shown, but the failed attempt did not explain that prerequisite.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting ATP to two different cell jobs made me curious about how later structures work.
